#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long mod = 998244353;
    int n;
    int m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        modInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mult(p, n - i, smallInv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long sign = paritySign(k + 1);
            long long numPhases = mult(m + k, smallInv(k));
            long long term = mult(sign, ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
            answer = add(answer, term);
        }

        out << answer << endl;
    }

private:
    long long fact(int n) {
        while (factorial.size() <= n) {
            factorial.push((int) mult(factorial.back(), factorial.size()));
        }

        return factorial.back();
    }

    long long fInv(int n) {
        int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;

        if (lastKnown < n) {
            long long* fInv = new long[n - lastKnown];
            fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
            for (int i = 1; i < fInv.length; i++) {
                fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
            }
            for (int i = fInv.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                invFactorial.push((int) fInv[i]);
            }
            delete[] fInv;
        }

        return invFactorial.back();
    }

    long long paritySign(long k) {
        return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : mod - 1;
    }

    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        assert(n >= 0);
        if (r < 0 || n < r)
            return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }

    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }

    long long normalize(long x) {
        x %= mod;
        if (x < 0)
            x += mod;
        return x;
    }

    long long add(long a, long b) {
        long v = a + b;
        return v < mod ? v : v - mod;
    }

    long long mult(long... x) {
        long r = 1;
        for (long i : x)
            r = mult(r, i);
        return r;
    }

    long long mult(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    long long inv(long value) {
        long g = mod, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long q = g / r;
            g %= r;

            long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;

            x -= q * y;

            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }

        assert(g == 1);
        assert(y == mod || y == -mod);

        return normalize(x);
    }

    vector<int> factorial;
    vector<int> invFactorial;

    void modInv(int n) {
        factorial.clear();
        invFactorial.clear();
        factorial.push_back(1);
        invFactorial.push_back(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            factorial.push_back((int) mult(factorial.back(), i));
            invFactorial.push_back((int) inv(factorial.back()));
        }
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    string next() {
        while (tokenizer == nullptr || !tokenizer->hasNext()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error(e.what());
            }
        }
        return tokenizer->nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

private:
    istream& reader;
    StringTokenizer* tokenizer;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream), tokenizer(nullptr) {}
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    ostream& out = cout;
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}

class StringTokenizer {
public:
    string nextToken() {
        while (tokens.empty()) {
            try {
                tokens = split(nextLine());
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error(e.what());
            }
        }
        string token = tokens.front();
        tokens.erase(tokens.begin());
        return token;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        return !tokens.empty();
    }

private:
    vector<string> tokens;

    vector<string> split(const string& str) {
        vector<string> tokens;
        stringstream ss(str);
        string token;
        while (ss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string line;
        getline(reader, line);
        return line;
    }

    istream& reader;
    StringTokenizer(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}
};
